scope: 50 open-validation historical Rarámuri-form records across printed pp. 322–345, with direct high-resolution recollation of character sequences, diacritics, article structure, and selected long entries

records.previous_reading: Grauen. Ikitsíki.
records.proposed_reading: Grauen. Ikitsiki.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent
records.note: The enlarged p. 322 source prints Ikitsiki with ordinary dotted i characters and no acute accent.

records.previous_reading: Greifen. Tſchapí.
records.proposed_reading: Greifen. Tſchapi.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent
records.note: The enlarged p. 322 source prints Tſchapi without an acute accent.
The historical consonant sequence and acute accent are graphically supported.

records.previous_reading: Heide, Tà pagotúgameke. d. i. ungetauft.
records.proposed_reading: Heide, Ta pagotúgameke. d. i. ungetauft.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported grave accent
records.note: The enlarged p. 323 source prints Ta without a grave accent; source-period wording is preserved without endorsement.
The grave on nè and final acute in ſimí are visibly supported by p. 324.

records.confirmed_reading: Herr [long historical sociopolitical article ending with Calſike].
records.note: The article extent and final historical form Calſike are stable; source-period social terminology remains documentary evidence.

records.confirmed_reading: Himmel [article with guami repa, guami reguiki, and revegátſchi].
records.note: The three documentary forms are supported at article level; semantic interpretation remains independent.

records.previous_reading: Hülſenfrucht, Muni. ... Linſen, Muni tſchiperámeke. Glatte Hülſenfrüchte, Muni cavolámeke ...
records.proposed_reading: Hülſenfrucht, Muni. ... Linſen, Muni tſchiperameke. Glatte Hülſenfrüchte, Muni cavolameke ...
records.correction_scope: remove two unsupported acute accents in internal crop/legume forms
records.note: High-resolution p. 325 clearly preserves the article structure but not acute accents in tſchiperameke or cavolameke; botanical identification remains independent.

records.previous_reading: Huhn, Totolí.
records.proposed_reading: Huhn, Totoli.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported final acute accent
records.note: The final i is an ordinary dotted i in the high-resolution source; no acute mark is supported.

records.previous_reading: Ja, ú. Erú. Hù. Húli. Húne. Hútſine. ...
records.proposed_reading: Ja, ü. Erú. Hù. Húli. Húne. Hútſine. ...
records.correction_scope: restore printed umlaut in first affirmative response form
records.note: Direct enlargement clearly reads ü as the first response form; the remainder of the long pragmatic article is structurally confirmed.

records.previous_reading: Ich, Ne, nehé, neheli, negótle, nemegótle. Mit, netſchi. Ich ſelbſt, Nemogótle. Bonaje. Mit mir, retſchijega, oder, netſchi juſega. ...
records.proposed_reading: Ich, Né, nehé, neheli, negótle, nemegótle. Mir, netſchi. Ich ſelbſt, Nemogótle. Bonaje. Mit mir, retſchijega, oder, netſchi jujega. Vor mir, in meiner Gegenwart, né batáni. ... Wir, tamé, tamehé. Wir ſelbſt, tamegótle.
records.correction_scope: restore visible accent on Né; correct German Mir and internal jujega
records.note: High-resolution p. 326 clearly supports Né, Mir and jujega. The printed neheli is retained conservatively without adding an unsupported acute.

records.previous_reading: Klein, Khuta. Kleiner, Khutabe. Kleinſte, Khuta ta ſimega.
records.proposed_reading: Klein, Khutá. Kleiner, Khutabé. Kleinſte, Khuta ta ſimega.
records.correction_scope: restore two visible acute accents
records.note: The acute marks on Khutá and Khutabé are clear in the enlarged source.
The historical German lemma and Rarámuri equivalent are graphically supported.

records.previous_reading: Keineswegs. Caità, ketà; ké-kotà.
records.proposed_reading: Keineswegs. Caità, ketà; Kékotà.
records.correction_scope: remove line-break hyphen and restore capitalization
records.note: The hyphen follows a typographic line break (Ké- / kotà) and is not lexical punctuation under the diplomatic policy.

records.previous_reading: Kind, Curſchigua. Klein Kind, Abíti, oder apíti.
records.proposed_reading: Kind, Curſchigua. Klein Kind, Abiti, oder apiti.
records.correction_scope: remove two unsupported acute accents from child-term variants
records.note: The high-resolution source shows ordinary dotted i characters without acute marks in both variants.

records.confirmed_reading: Kraut [ethnobotanical article with Páca, Kilibáca, Pejóte, Hícoli and Tſchináca].
records.note: Article structure and principal plant names are stable; botanical identification remains independent.
The phrase and visible diacritics are supported by direct inspection.

records.confirmed_reading: Lang, Beywort. Guelù. [Immediately followed by a second printed Lang, Nebenwort der Zeit... sequence.]
records.note: The first sense is graphically clear, but the repeated printed lemma leaves a lexicographic-structure question—one polyfunctional article versus two adjacent homographic articles. No merge or split is forced.

records.confirmed_reading: Lernen, Matſchiſimi [long grammatical article explaining ſimi].
records.note: Article extent and historical examples are stable; Steffel's grammatical analysis remains subject to independent linguistic review.

records.previous_reading: Machen, Jolá. Gemacht, Jolárugameke. Machen, der etwas macht, jolágemeke. Es iſt ſchon gemacht, Jolárupa.
records.proposed_reading: Machen, Jolá. Gemacht, Jolarugameke. Machen, der etwas macht, jolajameke. Es iſt ſchon gemacht, Jolárupa. Machen, Tegueke.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported accents, repair derived form, and restore omitted final variant
records.note: The enlarged p. 330 source reads Jolarugameke and jolajameke and includes the final variant Machen, Tegueke.

records.previous_reading: Mutter, Jejé. Mit einem Worte der zweyten Endung lautet es jejéla. ... Pedro jejéla. ...
records.proposed_reading: Mutter, Jeje. Mit einem Worte der zweyten Endung lautet es jejela. ... Pedro jejela. ...
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accents from Jeje/jejela forms
records.note: High-resolution pp. 332–333 consistently show unaccented Jeje/jejela; the long grammatical article structure is otherwise confirmed.
The headword, gloss and Rarámuri form are supported by direct inspection.
The compact medial consonant and acute accent are graphically supported.

records.confirmed_reading: Pflug. Baſſaráleke, oder Vaſſeráleke [long technical article continuing onto p. 336].
records.note: The opening forms and cross-page technical article are stable; historical technical terminology remains for independent review.

records.previous_reading: Prieſter. Páli. So nennten ſie die Miſſionarien ...
records.proposed_reading: Prieſter. Pali. So nennten ſie die Miſſionarien ...
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent from Pali
records.note: High-resolution p. 336 shows no acute mark on the a; historical metalinguistic framing remains source evidence.
The enlarged p. 336 source visibly supports the acute on a and the historical tſch sequence.

records.previous_reading: Reh. Tſchomalí. [long ethnographic article].
records.proposed_reading: Reh. Tſchomali. [long ethnographic article].
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported final acute accent
records.note: The enlarged p. 336 source prints Tſchomali without an acute accent; the long hunting article remains documentary evidence.

records.previous_reading: Roß. Cuú. Cajútschi.
records.proposed_reading: Roß. Caú. Cajútſchi.
records.correction_scope: repair first vowel of first equivalent and historical tſch sequence in second form
records.note: Direct enlargement of p. 338 supports Caú and Cajútſchi; no normalization of the historical cluster is introduced.
The historical German long s and acute accent in Mujájameke are supported.

records.confirmed_reading: Rufen. Bajé. Rufend, Bajéameke. Gerufen, Bajéliruc. Rufen ſollen, bajémela.
records.note: The paradigm and visible accents are supported by the facsimile.

records.previous_reading: Säen. Echtſchá. Säen ſollen, echtſámela. Geſäet, echutſchiruc.
records.proposed_reading: Säen. Echtſchá. Säen ſollen, echtſámela. Geſäet, Echtſchiruc.
records.correction_scope: remove spurious u and restore source form across typographic line break
records.note: The source splits the final form typographically as Echtſchi- / ruc; high-resolution collation supports Echtſchiruc.

records.confirmed_reading: Sagen. Tſaní. Rúje. Sag es, ruí.
records.note: The verb forms and visible accents are supported.
The form Ravéli and cross-reference are graphically supported.
The compound form and visible accents are supported.

records.previous_reading: Schafpelz. Pouguá guitſchía.
records.proposed_reading: Schafpelz. Pouguá guitſchíla.
records.correction_scope: restore omitted l in the Rarámuri form
records.note: The high-resolution source clearly reads guitſchíla.
The Rarámuri form and acute accent are supported.

records.previous_reading: Scheere. Náſſíla.
records.proposed_reading: Scheere. Naſſíla.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent from first vowel
records.note: Only the later i carries the marked accent in the enlarged source.

records.confirmed_reading: Scheinen. Rachelé. Es ſcheinet mir, ich halte dafür. Mijé.
records.note: Both historical forms and their visible accents are supported.

records.previous_reading: Schleunig, Gualiréke. Belágo.
records.proposed_reading: Schleunig, Gualiréke: Belágo.
records.correction_scope: restore source colon between the two forms
records.note: The enlarged p. 339 source clearly uses a colon after Gualiréke.
The historical German spelling and the Rarámuri form Kepä are retained as printed.

records.previous_reading: Schwißſtube. Te nalcáli. ſ. Badſtube.
records.proposed_reading: Schwißſtube. Temalcali. ſ. Badſtube.
records.correction_scope: join and correct compact Rarámuri form; remove unsupported acute
records.note: High-resolution p. 340 reads one continuous unaccented form Temalcali.
The ordinal form is graphically supported.

records.previous_reading: See. Pauguimaníla. Pauguiman ki.
records.proposed_reading: See. Pauguimanila. Pauguimaniki.
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent and erroneous internal space
records.note: High-resolution p. 340 shows two continuous unaccented forms.

records.previous_reading: Sehen. Nené, Retegua. Mattchi. Blöd, oder übel ſehen, tane gá mattchi, oder nehé tá gá mátchi. Sieh, nini.
records.proposed_reading: Sehen. Nené, Ketegua. Matſchi. Blöd, oder übel ſehen, táne gá matſchi, oder nehé tá gá matſchi. Sieh, nini.
records.correction_scope: repair initial consonant, historical tſch sequence, and visible diacritics
records.note: High-resolution p. 340 clearly supports Ketegua, Matſchi and táne; both later matſchi forms are unaccented.

records.previous_reading: Seyn, Húcu. Gatíki oder gatiki, wenn der Ort einer Perſon ...
records.proposed_reading: Seyn, Húcu. Gatiki oder gatiki, wenn der Ort einer Perſon ...
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute accent in first Gatiki
records.note: The enlarged p. 341 source prints Gatiki without an acute accent; semantic interpretation remains independent.

records.previous_reading: Speiſe, Coajámeke. Gute, ſchmackhafte Speiſe, coiguála. Patéma, iſt eine in der Erde gebratene Speiſe. ...
records.proposed_reading: Speiſe, Coajámeke. Gute, ſchmackhafte Speiſe, coiguala. Tatéma, iſt eine in der Erde gebratene Speiſe. ...
records.correction_scope: remove unsupported acute in coiguala and repair historical food term
records.note: High-resolution p. 342 clearly reads coiguala and Tatéma; the rest of the food article remains structurally confirmed.

records.previous_reading: Spiel. Eines der vornehmſten Tarahumariſchen Spiele iſt Ualshipoa ... Denn tala Fuß, und huma laufen, machen das Wort Talahüwali, Fußläufer aus. ...
records.proposed_reading: Spiel. Eines der vornehmſten Tarahumariſchen Spiele iſt Talahipoa, welches mit ihrem Namen Tarahumari, oder Talahumali gar wohl übereinkommt. Denn talá Fuß, und humá laufen, machen das Wort Talahúmali, Fußläufer aus. ...
records.correction_scope: repair historical game name, constituent forms, and visible acute accents
records.note: High-resolution p. 342 supports Talahipoa, unaccented Tarahumari/Talahumali, talá, humá and Talahúmali; the long article continues onto p. 343.

records.previous_reading: Stein, Teéke, techéke. Steinerne Säule, telé ulíameke, Zerſtoßener Stein, tecubírameke. ...
records.proposed_reading: Stein, Teéke, techtéke. Steinerne Säule, teé uliameke. Zerſtoßener Stein, tecubírameke. ...
records.correction_scope: repair consonant sequence and second phrase
records.note: The enlarged p. 344 source clearly prints techtéke and teé uliameke; the longer toponymic article remains for specialist review.

records.previous_reading: Strick, Buila. [long material-culture article; later guila and cató guila].
records.proposed_reading: Strick, Duila. [long material-culture article; later guila and cató guila].
records.correction_scope: repair initial consonant of the Rarámuri equivalent
records.note: The enlarged p. 344 source reads Duila, not Buila; later guila and cató guila are retained.

records.confirmed_reading: Suppe, Tſchorike Pauguila. — Kioliki iſt eine gekochte dünne Suppe von türkiſchen Waizengries. Sie heißt auch noch anders eskiate. ſ. Gries.
records.note: The culinary terms and cross-reference are sustained by high-resolution inspection; no unsupported acute is added to Pauguila.
